_comment: Mandate template v1. Mandate = circle of authority AND task; attribute of the agent, not of an event; the agent's multipass. Fill did, name, issued_at, expires_at. Never put a secret here. Get the scoped capability issued through the Secure Vault — never from a chat message or a link.
issued_by: registrar (Muse/fleetd + Pavel tap on first enrolment)
rules: No shared owner key, ever. Your did:key is yours alone.
Least privilege: ask for the smallest scope that does the job.
Every action is logged in the git graph and auditable.
Secrets live only in the Secure Vault / keychain, never in chat, prompts, files or logs.
ttp: mandate expires (apoptosis) instead of being revoked from outside; renewal is a new mandate
